demonstrates: An explicit authoritative deletion. The mail Field's manifest declares authoritative tombstones, so a delete record for one portable source key removes that current Note. The delete carries the key, its authority, and the observation instant, and no content at all.
notes: Deletion authority is declared once in the manifest and checked on every delete record. A Field whose manifest declares 'tombstones: unsupported' has its delete records rejected, so a connector cannot acquire deletion power by emitting a frame.

collection.refetch_note: Refetch is bounded by the mailbox retention and by any folder the granted scope cannot read.

deletion.note: The change feed reports removals explicitly; no complete-mailbox snapshot is claimed, so absence alone never deletes.

limitations.message: Messages purged from the mailbox before the first sync are not recoverable.

detail: Version 1, revision 0. The manifest declares 'deletion.tombstones: authoritative' and 'deletion.snapshot: unsupported', so absence alone can never delete for this Field.

The manifest declares authoritative tombstones and the record declares 'authority: tombstone', so core removes the current Note for that exact source key atomically. No tombstone record and no revision entry is written; a later refetch may recreate the Note under a new Note ID.
The removal is durable, so the delta cursor advances.
Referenced artifacts are not deleted here: shared originals are reclaimed only by a separate verified reference-analysis pass.
